items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Bob Lyons and oh, I guess Frankie Deucin and all those guys. That was E-ball.

ctx.x: What other streets? I don't even remember that street. Up in Carlton. That's where up in Carlton.

Down in French, part of town. Around Perdita Street. I know you know those places. That's by Larry Armstrong. Yeah, Larry Armstrong. And Perdita and Rampard, different band. Bob Lyons and oh, I guess Frankie Deucin and all those guys. That was E-ball. Yeah, he played Trumbull. He was good. Very good. Tell me some more about your teachers. Oh, yeah. Now, a fellow that mostly, I got instruction from after my uncle died. I got from a fellow by the name of Jim Humphrey. Jim Humphrey. He had three or four sons.…
Mr. Welch, what was his first name?
